card.title: 136. GEBIRGSJÄGER
card.flavorText: The 136th Mountain Infantry Regiment was a regiment of the 2nd Mountain Division of the Wehrmacht which was formed in 1938 and trained in operating in mountainous terrain and cold weather. The division was formed with personnel from the 6th Division of the Austrian Alpenkorps and most men serving in it came from the Salzburg and Tyrol regions of Austria. During WWII the division served in Norway and the northern sectors near the Arctic on the Eastern Front before being moved to the Western Front by the end of the war. The division fought with Army Group South during the Invasion of Poland in 1939 and in the Norwegian Campaign in 1940. During Operation Barbarossa the 2nd Mountain Division fought with Mountain Corps Norway alongside the Finnish Army against the Red Army in the Arctic region where it continued to serve until the hostilities between Finland and USSR ended in 1944. The division ended the war on the Western Front where it surrendered to the Western Allies.
